fix_subject: Only evaluate expressions once for UPDATE and INSERT statements that have BEFORE triggers.  Fix for ticket #980. (CVS 2158)
Fix an assertion failure due to interaction between the count_changes pragma and triggers. (CVS 2187)
NULL values in a row of a unique index cause the row to be distinct. Ticket #1301.  More testing and optimization needs to be done on this before closing the ticket. (CVS 2526)
Make sure there is only one busy counter.  Ticket #1315. (CVS 2543)
Disable synchronous writes to the master journal when PRAGMA synchronous=OFF for all database files.  Ticket #1375. (CVS 2630)
The LIKE optimization does the right thing when collating sequences are present.  LIKE expressions where the left-hand side has COLLATE NOCASE are optimized in the default case. (CVS 2637)
Fix ANALYZE so that it works even if the empty_result_callbacks pragma is enabled. Ticket #1409. (CVS 2659)
A SUM() of all NULLs returns NULL.  A SUM() of nothing return 0. A SUM() of a mixture of NULLs and numbers returns the sum of the numbers.  Ticket #1413. (CVS 2677)
Bug fix in the new COUNT(DISTINCT) logic.  Ticket #1420. (CVS 2689)
Make sure dependencies on the right-hand side of IN operators are checked correctly.  Ticket #1433. (CVS 2706)
Do not optimize views with an ORDER BY clause if they are used in a UNION ALL that also has an ORDER BY clause.  Ticket #1444. (CVS 2723)
More efficient handling of the LIMIT clause.  Scalar subqueries and EXISTS on compound SELECT statements now working properly.  Ticket #1473. (CVS 2747)
Report an error if the input SQL contains an unterminated string. Ticket #1497. (CVS 2751)
Do not allow aggregate functions in a WHERE clause.  Ticket #1514. (CVS 2769)
Fix incorrect type conversions when copying from a table into itself. Ticket #1536. (CVS 2773)
Bug fixes and additional testing of descending indices. (CVS 2841)
Bug fix in the IF NOT EXISTS logic. (CVS 2858)
Get LIMIT and OFFSET working again for negative limits and offsets. Ticket #1586. (CVS 2889)
Automatically cast BLOBs to strings prior to handing them over to functions like LIKE that want strings.  Ticket #1605. (CVS 2928)
Make sure the authenticator does not try to authenticate columns in subqueries.   Ticket #1607. (CVS 2939)
Bug fix in cases where a compound select has an ORDER BY clause with multiple terms. (CVS 3011)
Expire all prepared statements whenever there is a change to the schema of the TEMP database.  Ticket #1644. (CVS 3036)
Make sure the 3rd parameter to sqlite3_prepare() is honored.  Ticket #1650. (CVS 3040)
Authorization callback on the ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN command. Ticket #1479. (CVS 3043)
Detect circularly defined views and issue an error message.  Ticket #1658. (CVS 3055)
Integer overflow in SUM causes an exception.  Ticket #1669. (CVS 3064)
Avoid overflowing the 48-bit mantissa of a floating point number when summing large integers in the SUM() function.  Ticket #1664. (CVS 3061)
Correctly handle COLLATE clauses in tables being modified by an ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN command.  Ticket #1665. (CVS 3060)
Ensure temp db is open before executing a pragma like "temp.cachesize = xxx". Fix for #1682. (CVS 3104)
Detect integer overflow in the abs() function.  The random() function now provides 64 bits of randomness instead of just 32.  Fix bugs in testing logic of test4.c. (CVS 3108)
Change the ROUND() function to return a REAL value instead of TEXT. Ticket #1699. (CVS 3116)
Ignore leading spaces on text to numeric conversions.  Ticket #1662. Fixes to test cases broken by the recent changes to round(). (CVS 3118)
Correct names returned from a query against a view.  Ticket #1709, #1688, #1711. (CVS 3128)
Fix CHECK constraints to use alternative conflict resolution.  Ticket #1717. (CVS 3137)
Properly record the names of triggers even if the name is quoted. Ticket #1737. (CVS 3158)
When opening a new connection on a shared cache, be careful not to overwrite the encoding flag on the shared cache.  Ticket #1824. (CVS 3190)
Handle NULL database names in ATTACH and DETACH as if they were empty strings.  Ticket #1825. (CVS 3191)
Add tests for error conditions surrounding the creation/connection of virtual tables. (CVS 3235)
Add tests (and fixes) for the virtual table transaction interface. (CVS 3265)
Respect default collation sequences assigned to virtual table columns. (CVS 3272)
Fix a problem with virtual tables and joins. (CVS 3278)
Fix a file descriptor leak following malloc failure on DROP TABLE IF EXISTS. (CVS 3296)
Prevent databases from being DETACHed while they are in use. Fix for #1873. (CVS 3312)
Require whitespace or punctuation between a numeric literal and an identifier or keyword.  Ticket #1912. (CVS 3345)
Bug fix:  Get INSERT INTO ... SELECT working when the target is a virtual table. (CVS 3374)

Be sure to ignore PRAGMA encoding pragmas if the encoding has already been set for a database.  Ticket #1987.  This patch also includes some cleanup of the schema parser and initialization logic. (CVS 3436)
Make sure the names of all expressions in compound SELECT statements used as subqueries are correctly resolved.  Ticket #2018. (CVS 3477)
Fix a bug in the optimizer that was causing it to miss an OR optimization opportunity. (CVS 3502)
Fix a critical bug in sqlite3_prepare_v2 that can lead to segfaults when the schema changes and the statement is recompiled automatically. Ticket #2154. (CVS 3576)
Fix a bug in sqlite3_prepare_v2() introduced by checkin (3578) and reported on the mailing list. (CVS 3592)

Make sure the IS NULL optimization introduced by check-in (3494) correctly handles a LEFT JOIN where the a term from the right table of the join uses an IS NULL constraint.  Ticket #2177.  This check-in also adds the new test cases that were suppose to have been added with (3494) but which were mistakenly omitted. (CVS 3595)

When optimizing out an ORDER BY clause due to uniqueness constraints, make sure unused terms to the right in the ORDER BY clause to not reference other tables in a join.  Ticket #2211.  Additional test cases needed before closing this ticket. (CVS 3629)
Disable the OR optimization if it would conflict with column affinity coercions.  Ticket #2249.  Additional cleanup and testing of the OR optimization. (CVS 3658)
Make sure the INSERT xfer optimization does not trigger if the CHECK constraints on the two tables are not identical.  Ticket #2252. (CVS 3660)

Make sure that integer values are converted to real when pulled from a REAL table column by GROUP BY.  Ticket #2251.  Also make sure default values are correctly expanded.  There may be other places in the code where this issue comes up - we need to look further. (CVS 3659)
Zero cached pages located beyond the end of the file before returning them. Ticket #2285. (CVS 3808)
Binary file I/O infrastructure added and used to increase test coverage for detection of corrupt database files. (CVS 3822)

Make sure the sqlite3BtreePrevious() routine terminates properly if the table is deleted out from under it.  Ticket #2286.  This bug was discovered while trying to increase test coverage from 98.5% to 99% - once again showing the value of full coverage testing. (CVS 3818)

Get the column affinities right when processing an IN operator where the right-hand side is a subquery with an ORDER BY clause.  Ticket #2295. This bug has likely been present since version 3.0.0 and it has just now been noticed, so it seems to be a obscure case. (CVS 3837)
Match ORDER BY terms to columns using names in compound queries.  Make sure this works for subqueries, especially in the right-hand side of an IN operator. Ticket #2296. (CVS 3842)
Fix segfaults that can occur if a malloc failure happens just before a built-in function calls sqlite3_value_text(). (CVS 3874)
Fix a bug in the sqlite3_changes() function reported on the mailing list. (CVS 3868)
Internationalize the TRIM functions.  Ticket #2323. (CVS 3883)
Make sure zeroblob() works with the concatenation operator.  Ticket #2379. (CVS 4028)
Consider explicit collate clauses when matching WHERE constraints to indices. Fix for #2391. (CVS 4040)
Fix a problem with zeroblob() and CAST(...) expressions that could cause an assert() to fail. (CVS 4041)
Make sure rowid comparisons against NULL work correctly.  Ticket #2404. (CVS 4050)
Fix the query optimizer so that it correctly handles constant expressions in the ON clause of a LEFT JOIN.  Ticket #2403. (CVS 4049)
Fix a bug in the LIKE optimization that was causing the pattern string to be dequoted twice.  Ticket #2407. (CVS 4056)
Fix for #2415. The progress handler should abandon only the current query, not all active queries. (CVS 4067)
Do not segfault even if sqlite is misused by requesting query results after the query has been reset.  ticket #2426. (CVS 4090)
Disallow empty GROUP BY clauses.  Ticket #2431. (CVS 4099)
When expanding '*' in the result set of a SELECT, quote the expanded identifiers. Fix for #2450. (CVS 4111)
Set the connection error code when sqlite3_blob_read() or sqlite3_blob_write() fail.  Ticket #2464. (CVS 4137)
Fix for #2497. Set the database error code to the return value of sqlite3_step(). (CVS 4155)
Get the min/max optimization working with descending indices.  Ticket #2514. (CVS 4161)
Preliminary fix for ticket #2518.  Make sure the VACUUM command increments the change counter. (CVS 4163)
Detect nested aggregate functions even if the inner aggregate function is aliased using an AS clause.  Ticket #2526. (CVS 4179)
The REPLACE conflict resolution falls back to FAIL when on a CHECK constraint violation.  Ticket #2525. (CVS 4178)
Return an error when an xBestIndex() method indicates that it intends to use the value of an unusable constraint. Related to #2998. (CVS 4867)

Make sure an imbalance in the number of columns on a compound SELECT is detected and reported as an error before it can cause an assertion fault or array-bounds overflow in the code generator. Oops: part of the fix for ticket #3015 got included with this check-in by mistake. (CVS 4917)
Fix for #3022. Handle queries like "SELECT min(b) FROM T WHERE a = X AND b > X" when there is an index on (a,b). (CVS 4930)
Initial test cases and bug fixes in the CSE logic. (CVS 4946)
Avoid an out-of-bounds read in sqlite3_prepare() and fix a case where the output variable *pzTail was being set incorrectly. Fix for #3027. (CVS 4957)
Make sure changes to virtual tables are counted the same as real tables. Ticket #3038. (CVS 4976)
Do not attempt to omit unused columns of a view in an instead-of trigger since sometimes those columns can be used in ways that we do not expect. Ticket #3055. (CVS 5012)
Fix a bug in the RTRIM collating sequence discovered while working on condition/decision branch coverage.  Increase test coverage of the date/time functions. (CVS 5010)

Additional work on ticket #3015.  The previous fix (check-in (4919)) did not appear to work in all cases and it disabled indexing in some places where it should not have.  New test cases added to help insure that the current fix is better. (CVS 5026)
Ensure that it is not possible to open either virtual table or view columns using the blob API. Ticket #3078. (CVS 5041)
Always convert IEEE NaN into NULL.  Ticket #3060.  Add test cases to verify that this is happening. (CVS 5066)
Fix some problems with multi-file transactions in persistent journal mode. (CVS 5102)
Added test cases for corrupt SerialTypeLen header values, and additional check to improve detection of corrupt values. (CVS 5101)

New test cases to verify that SQLite handles bound NaN, +Inf, and -Inf floating point values correctly.  Improvements to the text->real conversion routine so that it generates +Inf and -Inf at appropriate times. Tickets #3101 and #3060. (CVS 5116)
Do not attempt to write a master journal name to the (non-existent) journal file in "no-journal" mode. Fix for #3127. (CVS 5145)
Fix the LIKE query optimizer so that it works with LIKE patterns ending in '@%' on NOCASE columns.  Ticket #3139. (CVS 5158)
When initializing the sqlite_sequence entry for an AUTOINCREMENT table, make sure the value is an reasonable integer even if the initial insert failed.  Ticket #3148. (CVS 5175)

Fix a problem with the incremental blob API. sqlite3_blob_open() was always reading the data for the leftmost column of the row that the opened blob was stored in. If this column happened to contain a (the) large blob, sqlite would make a large memory allocation to read the data into. Which defeats the purpose of using incremental blobs. (CVS 5222)
Implicit string->numeric conversion should go to an integer value when possible.  Ticket #3257. (CVS 5502)
Make sure "rowid" columns in views are named correctly.  Ticket #3308. (CVS 5580)
Allow the WHERE clause in an UPDATE or DELETE against a view with an INSTEAD OF trigger to refer to the view by name.  Ticket #3298. (CVS 5589)
Do not flatten subqueries where the subquery has a LIMIT and the outer query has a WHERE clause.  Ticket #3334. (CVS 5613)
If the 'rootpage' column of the sqlite_master table contains a NULL value, return SQLITE_CORRUPT to the caller. (CVS 5681)

Calling sqlite3_create_function with nArg==(-1) does not override prior calls on the same function name with nArg>=0.  Ticket #3345.  Add the new -argcount option to the "function" method in the TCL interface. (CVS 5684)
Fix for handling database files corrupted in such a was as to make a b-tree page a direct or indirect descendant of itself. (CVS 5689)
Fix the NEAR connector in FTS3 so that it can take ranges in excess of 9. The maximum range is now 32767. (CVS 5695)
If the xAccess() call used by "PRAGMA temp_store_directory = /new/path/" to determine if the supplied directory is writable returns an error, assume the directory is not writable. (CVS 5707)
Fix for sqlite3_blob_write(): If either 3rd or 4th argument is less than zero, return SQLITE_ERROR. H17879. (CVS 5762)
After an OP_NullRow is executed on a cursor, cause any subsequent OP_Next or OP_Prev to behave as if there were no more rows to traverse. Ticket #3424. (CVS 5782)
Fix an assert() failure that can occur if the user attempts to set an into an integer primary key column to a text value in a table that has a BEFORE UPDATE trigger. (CVS 5787)
Fix a bug in pragma table_info. Column default values specified as negative numbers (col DEFAULT -1) were being reported as NULL by the pragma. (CVS 5839)

If a hot-journal file is detected but the application does not have the required read/write permissions, return SQLITE_CANTOPEN. Prior to this change, SQLITE_BUSY was returned. Ticket #3457. (CVS 5849)
Prevent buffer overruns when converting malformed UTF16 to UTF8.  Ticket #3482. (CVS 5869)
Fixed crash in integrity_check with corrupt content offset size in page header. (CVS 5881)
Make sure affinities and implicit collation sequences are correctly used by comparison expressions in the select-list or having clause of an aggregate query. Ticket #3493. (CVS 5889)
Fixed several more crashes due to corrupt db files.  Added corruptC.test to soak.test. (CVS 5905)
Expand table.* properly on a USING or a NATURAL join.  Ticket #3522. (CVS 5979)

A subquery in the result set of a SELECT should be able to look into outer queries to find variable references.  But a subquery in the FROM clause should not be able to do this.  Ticket #3530. (CVS 5998)
Rework the rowid lookup logic in the query optimizer to fix various boundary value problems.  Ticket #3536.  Renamed the OP_MoveXX opcodes to OP_SeekXX. (CVS 6024)
Convert the "~" and "NOT" operators to be two-address instructions. Ticket #3541. (CVS 6028)
When the commit_hook calls a query recursively, make sure the commit_hook is not invoked recursively.  Ticket #3564. (CVS 6107)
Fix a problem in the WHERE clause generator when the FROM clause is empty. (CVS 6114)
Fix savepoint related bugs. A rollback caused by an IO error or "OR ROLLBACK" clause while one or more savepoints were open was leaving the sqlite3 structure in an invalid state. (CVS 6128)
Fix a problem with reverting a 'DROP TABLE' command executed inside of a savepoint on an auto-vacuum database. (CVS 6129)
Fix a bug in the LIKE query optimization.  (Found by coverage testing.) (CVS 6137)
Fix a couple of potential corruption problems in pager.c. (CVS 6143)
Increase test coverage of where.c.  Make sure OR-optimization works on UPDATE and DELETE in addition to SELECT.  (Bug found by coverage tests.) (CVS 6139)
Fix a problem with committing a transaction while there are other active statements. Sometimes, the database change counter was not being updated. (CVS 6176)
Allow recently added keywords 'savepoint' and 'release' to be used as database object names. Just as they could be prior to 3.6.8. Ticket #3590. (CVS 6186)
Fix a bug that was preventing SQLite from releasing locks properly under obscure circumstances. (CVS 6192)
Fix the VACUUM command so that it does not commit a transaction when it is mistakenly run within a transaction - it should leave the transaction open. (CVS 6200)
Better error message when coalesce() has too few arguments.  Ticket #3623. (CVS 6222)
Fix SUBSTR() so that it returns NULL if any argument is NULL. Ticket #3626. (CVS 6228)
Omit the TEMP keyword from the schema of TEMP tables created using CREATE TEMP TABLE AS SELECT .....  Ticket #3630. (CVS 6232)
Do not attempt to use the sub-journal file descriptor if it is not opened (as in journal_mode=off mode). Ticket #3636. (CVS 6252)
Correctly handle attempts to add a UNIQUE or PRIMARY KEY column using the ALTER TABLE statement.  Ticket #3651. (CVS 6291)
Make sure the auto_vacuum=INCREMENTAL setting is preserved across a VACUUM. Ticket #3663. (CVS 6304)
Instead of linking temporary triggers on non-temporary tables into the Table.pTrigger list, search the temp schema for them on demand. Fix for #3688. (CVS 6329)
Avoid fts3 crash on (MATCH '""') expressions. Ticket #3717. (CVS 6343)
Move the rowid cache out of VdbeCursor and into BtCursor.  When multiple BtCursors are open on the same table, set their rowid cache all at the same time.  Ticket #3731. (CVS 6354)
Fix a crash that could occur when creating an index in shared-cache mode with lookaside enabled. (CVS 6358)
Check that the first byte of a potentially hot journal file is non-zero before beginning hot-journal rollback. Fix for #3751 and #3745. (CVS 6390)
Make sure count(*) works on the sqlite_master table of an empty database. Ticket #3774. (CVS 6443)
Fix a problem causing the BtShared.isPending flag to be cleared to early. Also coverage improvements for btree.c. (CVS 6440)
Ensure the required VerifyCookie/Transaction/TableLock opcodes are added for "x IN (SELECT c FROM t)" expressions. Ticket #3771. (CVS 6439)
Disable the query flattening optimization when the subquery is a compound query with an ORDER BY clause.  Ticket #3773 shows why that combination does not work. (CVS 6437)
Do not attempt to walk a TokenOnly or SpanOnly expression tree node. Ticket #3791. (CVS 6469)
Fix the group_concat() function so that it inserts the separator string even if the initial content strings are empty.  Ticket #3806. (CVS 6510)

Change the journal_mode pragma so that it always returns the current journal mode, even on a failed attempt to change the journal mode. Allow the journal mode to be changed as long as there is not a pending transaction.  Ticket #3811. (CVS 6526)
Make sure that the optimizer realizes that an "x IS NULL" contraint does not necessarily give a single-row result even on a UNIQUE index.  Ticket #3824. (CVS 6545)
Fix processing of BEFORE triggers on INSERT statements with RHS SELECTs that insert a NULL into the INTEGER PRIMARY KEY.  Ticket #3832. (CVS 6583)
Make sure the default value on a column added using ALTER TABLE has the correct encoding.  Ticket #3838. (CVS 6603)
Use caution to avoid integer overflow when doing real to integer affinity operations.  Ticket #3922. (CVS 6776)
Fix for #3918. Also, fix the TRACE macros in balance_nonroot(). (CVS 6772)
Enhance autoincrement so that it works with triggers that also do autoincrement inserts, even multiple inserts into the same table. Ticket #3928 (CVS 6807)
Do not ignore alias "a" in a query of the form "SELECT ... FROM (...) AS a" Fix for #3935. Also expand upon (6751) to fix some similar obscure memory leaks. (CVS 6831)
Report an error if a USING or ON clause is specified following a from-list element that is not to the right of a join operator. Fix for #3846. (CVS 6832)
Fix to sqlite3AuthRead to accommodate "new" or "old" references that are used in a context where a column reference may also be used (i.e. "SELECT new.<col> FROM <tble>"). Ticket #3944. (CVS 6838)
When a b-tree transaction is committed when there are open cursors, downgrade shared-cache write-locks to read-locks instead of relinquishing all locks. Fix for #3942. (CVS 6837)
Fix a case where deleting a row from a corrupt database could cause an assert to fail. (CVS 6881)
Remove an assert ("assert( subpage>0 )") from btree.c that may not be true for a corrupt database. Also add comments and other assert() statements to btree.c function moveToRoot(). (CVS 6886)
Add the experimental API sqlite3_strnicmp(). Modify fts3 so that in terms like 'column_name:token' the column_name is interpreted in a case-insenstive fashion. Ticket #3996. (CVS 6950)
When flattening a SELECT query, do not discard collation sequences explicitly attached to expressions in the parent query. Fix for #3997. (CVS 6949)
Alternative fix for ticket #3810.  This is a replacement for check-in (6956). (CVS 6960)
Fix a case where SQLite may write past the end of a buffer as a result of a corrupted database file.

Add some tests that involve BEFORE UPDATE or BEFORE DELETE triggers messing with the row being updated or deleted. SQLite behaviour in this scenario is undefined, so the tests just check that the behaviour is relatively sane and there are no crashes.
Make sure sufficient space is allocated for at least one VDBE cursor when autoincrement is used.  Ticket [a696379c1f088].

When coding a trigger, assume that the "oldmask" requires all columns until we know otherwise.  That pessimistic assumption assures that all necessary parameters are available on a cascading delete trigger. Ticket [e25d9ea771f]
Fix a problem with foreign key constraints that map from and IPK column.
Fix an assert() that may fail if sqlite3_step() is called on a statement after a previous call has already returned SQLITE_SCHEMA.
When generating WHERE clause terms internally for NATURAL and USING joins, identify the table by its position in the FROM list, not by its name or alias. Fix for [b73fb0bd64].
When creating a trigger on a main database table when there is a TEMP table with the same name, make sure the trigger is bound to the main table. Ticket [985771e11612].
Modify the vdbe so that the comparison operator opcodes do not modify the data type of operands. Fix for [aa92c76cd4].
Fix for [9861b74ab9]. Correctly handle strings with zero tokens in the fts3 offsets() function.
Zero the "immediate FK constraint counter" associated with a statement object when sqlite3_reset() is called. Fix for [c39ff61c43].

Fix a bug whereby an old snapshot could be checkpointed (and subsequent transactions discarded) if the last connection to disconnect from a WAL database happended to be holding an out-of-date wal-index header.
Fix a problem with checkpointing large log files created by an external process.
Remove the OP_Variable optimization of check-in [48b77b04935d894] since it can lead to malfunctions as described in ticket [26ff0c82d1e90].

Make sure the value of an INTEGER PRIMARY KEY column supplied to triggers and especially to FK constraints really contains the ROWID and not the NULL that is stored in the column itself.  Ticket [dd08e5a988d00dec].
Fix a problem with rolling back to a savepoint opened before the writer decided to wrap the log file.
Rearrange some code in OP_JournalMode to avoid incorrect returns from subsequent invocations of "PRAGMA journal_mode" following an IO error.
Add further test cases. Fix an assert() in pager.c.
Fix a problem with writing to databases larger than 2^32 bytes with WAL mode.
Make the result of an IN or NOT IN expression with an empty set on the right-hand side always either false or true, respectively, even if the left-hand side is NULL.  Ticket [80e031a00f45dc]
Correct handling of compound foreign key constraints that include the integer primary key as one of the columns. Ticket [ce7c133ea6cc9ccdc1]
Cherry-pick the multi-file transaction fix for ticket [f3e5abed55] out of the experimental branch.
Fix the REPLACE conflict resolution so that it falls back to ABORT when a CHECK constraint fails.  Ticket [c38baa3d969eab794].
When opening a write-transaction on a database file that has been appended to or truncated by a pre-3.7.0 client, update the database-size field in the database header. Fix for [51ae9cad31].
Fix a problem wherein changing the journal-mode immediately after leaving exclusive-locking mode could lead to the database being unlocked without clearing the changeCountDone flag.
Do not apply the flattening optimization if the sub-query is DISTINCT. Fix for [e4b8a2ba6e].
Fix for ticket [5e10420e8d].
Fixes to allow fts3 tables to be renamed mid-transaction.
Fix some segfaults that could occur in obscure circumstances where error messages contained characters that could be mistaken for printf format specifiers.
Prevent an assert from failing when opening a zero-length database file with an apparently hot journal with locking_mode=exclusive set.
Further improvements to coverage of fts3.c. Fixes for bugs revealed by the same.
Fix a buffer overread in fts3 that can occur if the database is corrupt.
Fix the ANALYZE command so that it takes collating sequences into account when gathering index statistics.
Do not report corruption if the the db size header field is greater than the file size on disk unless the two change-counter header fields are identical. Fix for ticket [89b8c9ac54].
Fix a problem with "EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN SELECT count(*) FROM tbl".
When a stale schema-cookie is seen, expire only the one statement that encountered the bad cookie, not every statement on the database connection.  Ticket [b72787b1a7cea1f]
Fix issue with mem5 allocator when min request size is larger thatn 2^30.
Disable the transfer optimization if the destination table contains any foreign key constraint and foreign key constraints are enabled. Ticket [6284df89debdf].
Fix minor problems with foreign key constraints where the parent table is the same as the child table.
Fix for [54844eea3f]: Do not create automatic indexes on correlated sub-queries.
Test cases added.  Fix the query mode.
Fix for [b1d3a2e531].
When copying a rollback mode database over a WAL database using the backup API, leave the destination database in WAL mode (instead of switching it to rollback mode). Fix for [af95b8c609].
Disable the xfer optimization if "PRAGMA count_changes=1" is configured. Ticket [c48d99d690].
Make sure the query optimizer for aggregate queries knows that expressions (x='a') and (x='A') are different.  Ticket [fa7bf5ec94801e7e]
Make sure the page_count and quick_check pragmas work properly even when their names are capitalized.  Fixes a problem reported on the mailing list.
Avoid 32-bit integer overflow when evaluating the exponent of a floating point value during ascii to binary conversion.
Fix a floating-point exception that can occur when an FTS4 query contains a large number of tokens connected by AND or NEAR operators.
Fix the virtual table rename logic so that it works even if the database encoding is something other than UTF8. Ticket [8290242b2a9a81683]

If an error occurs within sqlite3_step() on a statement prepared using sqlite3_prepare_v2(), transfer both the error code and error message to the database handle before sqlite3_step() returns (so that they are available via sqlite3_errcode() and sqlite3_errmsg(). Prior to this commit, only the error code was transfered. The error message was not available until after either sqlite3_reset() or sqlite3_finalize() had been called on the statement handle.
Avoid attempting to call savepoint related methods on deleted sqlite3_vtab objects. Fix for [48f299634a].
Make sure the INSERT INTO ... SELECT statement works correctly even when the destination table contains an INTEGER PRIMARY KEY ON CONFLICT... column. Ticket [676bc02b87176125].
Modify the OP_Once opcode so that it works correctly in trigger sub-programs. This is a candidate fix for [7bbfb7d442].
Avoid 32-bit overflow when calculating the byte offset of an overflow page in SQLITE_DIRECT_OVERFLOW_READ code. Fix for [ac0ff496b7].
Remove some assert() statements that can fail with corrupt databases.
Fix an FTS problem triggered by querying for an N character prefix using an N+1 character prefix index after rows have been deleted from the FTS table.
Fix ALTER TABLE RENAME so that it correctly handles triggers that attach to the table using the name in a different case. Ticket [ae6794effd404].
Fix a problem with NULL handling in aggregate min/max when returning values from the row containing the min or max.
If the SQLITE_FCNTL_PRAGMA file-control returns anything other than SQLTIE_NOTFOUND and SQLITE_OK, then treat the result as an error.
Fix an obscure bug that causes a crash when parsing certain invalid SQL statements.
Fix spurious errors that may occur if an empty database is opened and then initialized as a WAL database by a second connection.
Fix problems with combining content= and languageid= in a single fts4 table.
Fix the FTS 'optimize' command on multi-lingual databases.
Cherrypick the [3475092cff] fix for 32-bit overflow with large language-ids into trunk.
Fix some integer overflow problems that can occur when using large langauge id values.
Remove an incorrect assert() statement. Fix a const-related warning.

When an incremental blob cursor is invalidated (occurs when an SQL statement modifies or deletes the row the blob cursor points to) release all page references held by the cursor. Otherwise, the presence of these references may cause other code in btree.c to incorrectly infer that the database is corrupt.

When an incremental blob cursor is invalidated (occurs when an SQL statement modifies or deletes the row the blob cursor points to) release all page references held by the cursor. Otherwise, the presence of these references may cause other code in btree.c to incorrectly infer that the database is corrupt.
Remove the fts3merge.test script in favour of changing the fts4merge.test script so that it runs tests using both fts4 and fts3. Fix some problems with incr-merge and FTS3 tables.

Fix for 2a5629202f. When considering whether or not a UNIQUE index may be used to optimize an ORDER BY clause, do not assume that all index entries are distinct unless there is some reason to believe that the index contains no NULL values.

Do not consider a DISTINCT clause redundant unless a subset of the result-set is collectively subject to a UNIQUE constraint and it can be guaranteed that all columns of the subset are NOT NULL (either due to NOT NULL constraints WHERE clause terms). Fix for [385a5b56b9].

Adjust the parser so that certain legacy schema constructs (that are not valid according to the syntax diagram) continue to be accepted, so that older databases that happen to use those constructs are still readable. This fixes an issue introduced by check-in [1b75f301affac6]

Fix a case where SQLite was failing to detect a syntax error in queries like "SELECT ... FROM (<select-1> UNION ALL <select-2>)" when <select-1> and <select-2> return different numbers of result columns.

Ensure that when the source of a backup is a database that is zero bytes in size, the final destination database consists of at least one page. Truncating it to zero bytes is equivalent to zeroing the schema cookie and change counter, which can cause problems for existing clients.
Fix a failing assert() in wal.c.
Fix a problem causing the "number-of-documents" field maintained by FTS4 to be set incorrectly.
Apply the same restrictions on constant refactoring to statements within a trigger program as top-level statements. Candidate fix for [ae3c5670b6].
Improved error messages when column integers in an ORDER BY clause are out of range.
Added test cases for PRAGMA foreign_key_check.  Fixed a bug that appears when the column order of the child and parent differ.
Ensure the database size field in the db header of a backup database is set correctly. Fix for [0cfd98ee201].
Do not raise an error if an unknown SQL function is found in a CHECK constraint while parsing the schema of an existing database.
When comparing names during name resolution, make sure the names match exactly and that one name isn't merely a prefix of the other. Fix for ticket [7a31705a7e6c95d51].
Candidate fix for ticket [6bfb98dfc0c]: Make sure invalid cursors drop all references to database pages prior to doing any insert or update.

A fix an test-case for the ORDER BY problem identified by ticket [a179fe7465]. This change causes sorting to occur in some cases where it is not strictly necessary.  Further work is needed to avoid those extra sorts.

Only consider AS names from the result set as candidates for resolving identifiers in the WHERE clause if there are no other matches.  In the ORDER BY clause, AS names take priority over any column names. Candidate fix for ticket [2500cdb9be].
Fix an off-by-one in the code for limiting the depth of FTS expression trees.
Make sure extra parentheses around subqueries in the FROM clause are harmless. Ticket [28c6e830f239ea5].
Make sure the authorizer callback gets a valid pointer to "ROWID" for the column-name parameter when doing an UPDATE that changes the rowid. Fix for ticket [0eb70d77cb05bb2272].
Make sure the ORDER BY collating sequences are compatible with the comparison collations before using the merge algorithm for compound SELECT statements.  Candidate fix for ticket [6709574d2a8d8].
Candidate fixes for problems revealed by notify2.test. Notify2.test is still failing at this point.

When loading a database schema that contains an index definition that includes a COLLATE clause for which the collation sequence is unavailable, do not assume that that index uses BINARY instead. Fix for [0fc59f908b].
When writing to an FTS table, take an exclusive shared-cache lock on the %_segdir table before writing. Otherwise, an xCommit() call may report an SQLITE_LOCKED error.
Make sure that GROUP BY terms select input column names in preference to output column names, in compliance with the SQL standard. Ticket [1c69be2dafc28].
Fix an invalid assert() in where.c. Also a crash that can occur in the EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN code under obscure circumstances.
Add test cases for tointeger() and toreal() functions.  Fixes for several tests.
Candidate fix for [d666d600a6].
Candidate fix for [9f2eb3abac]: Have the whereShortCut() planner ignore indexes with more than four columns.
Make sure the omit-noop-left-join optimization is not applied if columns of the LEFT JOIN are used in the ORDER BY clause. Ticket [be84e357c035]
Fix a faulty assert() in sqlite3BtreeBeginTrans() that may fail in shared-cache mode.
Obtain the required shared-cache write-lock when executing "DELETE FROM tbl" statements. Fix for [1e1321ee98].

Return an error if an attempt is made to create a trigger with an SQL variable embedded within it. If such a variable reference is found within a trigger definition loaded from the sqlite_master table, silently replace it with a NULL.
Make sure the count(*) optimization works correctly even when partial indices are present.  Ticket [a5c8ed66cae].
In "PRAGMA foreign_key_check", treat missing parent tables as empty (instead of as errors).
Fix handling of "DROP TABLE" commands when "PRAGMA defer_foreign_keys=1" is set.
Fix a bug causing an "malformed database schema error" error if a temp table with the same name as an existing table that has at least one temp trigger attached to it is created.
Report an error when trying to resolve column name "rowid" in a WITHOUT ROWID table.
Fix a bug preventing FTS from correctly processing bracket tokens that are immediately preceded by characters that are neither whitespace or token characters.
Add the conflict2.test script.  Fix issues discovered by this script.
Fix a problem in OP_IdxDelete as used by REPLACE conflict resolution that comes up due to recent enhancements that reduce the work required for UNIQUE NOT NULL indices.

Add test cases for skip-scan.  Enhance "do_test" so that if the expected result is of the form "/*..*/" or "~/*..*/" it treats the expected result as a glob pattern rather than as a regular expression.  Fix a bug in ANALYZE result loading associated with WITHOUT ROWID tables.

Make sure the update hook is not invoked for WITHOUT ROWID tables, as the documentation specifies.  This bug was found while adding requirements marks, so a few extraneous requirements marks are included in this check-in.
Fix the formatting of %c in the printf() SQL function.
Fix CREATE TABLE ... AS so that it works with column names that are empty strings.
Fix some problems to do with WITH clauses and name resolution.
Avoid spurious "no such table" errors in statements of the form "INSERT INTO tbl WITH xxx AS (...) SELECT * FROM xxx".
Handle a few obscure problems that could manifest if a database corrupted in a certain way was written by a connection in the middle of a SELECT statement on the same db.
Change the OP_Found opcode so that it expands zero-blobs prior to comparing them.  Fix for ticket [fccbde530a6583b]
Use the WITH clause to help resolve names for SELECT statements on the left of a compound query.  Proposed fix for ticket [31a19d11b97088296a].
Make sure "rowid" columns are correctly resolved in joins between normal tables and WITHOUT ROWID tables.  Fix for ticket [c34d0557f740c45070].
Improved handling of constants and especially constant functions in the ORDER BY clause of a query.  Do not optimize out "ORDER BY random()". Fix for ticket [65bdeb9739605cc2296].
Fix a problem with "DEFAULT (-(-9223372036854775808))" clauses in ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN commands.
Fix a bug causing "SELECT char()" to return SQLITE_NOMEM.
Fix an obscure bug causing sqlite3_close() to fail if there are virtual tables on the disconnect list when it is called.

Fix query planner weights associated with choosing block-sorting.  Fix block sorting of tables with collating functions.  Fix various test cases. All "veryquick" tests are now passing, though more tests need to be added.

The "x IN (?)" optimization in check-ins [2ff3b25f40] and [e68b427afb] is incorrect, as demonstrated by the in4-5.1 test case in this check-in. The "COLLATE binary" that was being added to the RHS of IN was overriding the implicit collating sequence of the LHS.  This change defines the EP_Generic expression node property that blocks all affinity or collating sequence information in the expression subtree and adds that property to the expression taken from RHS of the IN operator.

Previous check-in is not quite correct.  "x IN (?)" is not exactly the same as "x==?" do to collation and affinity issues.  The correct converstion should be to "x==(+? COLLATE binary)".  The current check-in fixes this problem and provides test cases.  Ticket [e39d032577df69]
Fix the OFFSET clause so that it works correctly on queries that lack a FROM clause.  Ticket [07d6a0453d4ed8].
Avoid leaking memory in an obscure case where the flattener adds an ORDER BY clause to the recursive part of a recursive query.
Fix a problem in the code added by [707ea170b3] causing vdbesort.c to sort unstably.
Modify the OR-clause handling so that it can safely deal with OR-clause with 17 or more terms.  Fix for ticket [10fb063b1179be53ea0b53bb].
Make sure column cache elements are cleared correctly when jumping over code for key generation in a partial index. Fix for ticket [2ea3e9fe6379fc3f6].
Avoid transfering records between tables unless the default values for all columns are the same. Fix for [f67b41381a].
Fix an sqlite3_stmt_status() problem caused by recent changs on this branch.
Fix an error in estimating of the number of rows visited by a range scan.
Do not reduce the number of rows scanned at all for "IS NOT NULL" constraints. Fix a bug in calculating the number of rows visited by scans of partial indicies.
Add tests so that the "coverage-sorter" test permutation covers all branches in vdbesort.c. Fix a few minor problems in the same file.
Fix nolock and immutable so that they work even if READONLY is requested.
Make sure the group_concat() function returns an empty string, not a NULL, if it has at least one input row.  Fix for ticket [55746f9e65f8587].
Fix a problem preventing delete markers from ever being removed from the FTS index.
Fix various problems to do with segment promotion. Add test file fts4growth2.test, containing tests to check that the FTS index does not grow indefinitely as the table is updated.
Fix a bug causing an incorrect segment size value to be stored if both an old and new FTS version performed work on the same incremental merge operation.
Fix the sqlite3_db_readonly() API so that it reports true if the database is readonly because the file format write version (byte 18 of the header) is too large.
Make sure sufficient VDBE registers are allocated for an INSERT...SELECT when there is an idlist on the insert table that includes an explicit rowid.  Ticket [9654505cfda93610585fde5a9bbf2e730c8a8d5]

Fix a problem in FTS4 where columns with names that are prefixes of any notindexed column were also being (incorrectly) marked as not indexed. For example in "CREATE ... t1(abc, bc, abcd, notindexed=abcd)", both abc and abcd were being treated as notindexed.
Fix the query planner so that it once again knows that queries without a FROM clause will never return more than one row and hence do not require sorting.
Fix a problem that was causing the FTS4 integrity-check command to fail if the table had one or more "notindexed" columns.
Fix where.c so that the primary key values appended to every index entry on a WITHOUT ROWID table may be used when useful.

The optimization of check-in [b67a6e33f2] does not work (it generates incorrect VDBE code) if an OR term is AND-ed with a constant expression. So back that optimization out and add a test case to make sure it does not get added back in.

Change the hex literal processing so that only the SQL parser understands hex literals.  Casting and coercing string literals into numeric values does not understand hexadecimal integers.  This preserves backwards compatibility. Also:  Throw an error on any hex literal that is too big to fit into 64 bits.
Ensure that aggregate functions are not used when evaluating a default value for a table column. Candidate fix for ticket [3a88d85f36704eebe134f7].

A simpler fix for ticket [3a88d85f36704eebe1] - one that uses less code. The error message is not quite as good, but as this error has apparently not previously occurred in over 8 years of heavy use, that is not seen as a serious problem.
Fix an assert that can fail if the database file is corrupted.
Make sure the sqlite3_trace() callback is invoked, even if the prepared statement was marked "expired" before it ever entered sqlite3_step(). Ticket [11d5aa455e0d98f3c1e6a08].

When determining whether or not a partial index is usable, do not assume that the cursor number assigned to each table in the query is the same as its index in the FROM clause. Fix for ticket [98d973b8f5].
Do not allow parameters in a DEFAULT clause of a CREATE TABLE statement. Ticket [78c0c8c3c9f7c1].
Ensure that the OP_Prev opcode verifies that content has not been deleted out from under the cursor.  Fix for ticket [209d31e3161b9e9ff].
Avoid a NULL pointer deference when processing the IS operator if the right-hand side is an illegal "#ID" style variable. Fix for ticket [8c32a33a53092c85a15b]
Account for the ASC/DESC properties of ORDER BY expressions when using the same index for GROUP BY and ORDER BY. Candidate fix for [ba7cbfaedc].
Modify the documentation for sqlite3_changes() to make it more testable. Add tests and minor fixes for the same.
Fix the %c format character in sqlite3VXPrintf() so that it correctly handles precisions larger than 70.
Fix the %c format character in sqlite3VXPrintf() so that it correctly handles precisions larger than 70.
Do not automatically remove the DISTINCT keyword from "a IN (SELECT DISTINCT ...)" expressions. Fix for [db87229497].

Fix the sqlite3_table_column_metadata() routine so that it gives the correct answer for the "rowid" column in a WITHOUT ROWID table.  Enhance it so that it can be used to check for the existence of a table by setting the column name parameter to NULL.  The routine is now included in the build by default, even without the SQLITE_ENABLE_COLUMN_METADATA compile-time option.
Fix three crash problems discovered by afl-fuzz. Ticket [a59ae93ee990a55].

Make sure errors in the FROM clause of a SELECT cause analysis to abort and unwind the stack before those errors have a chance to mischief in the "*" column-name wildcard expander. Fix for ticket [32b63d542433ca67].
Fix a bug in the fts3 snippet() function causing it to omit leading separator characters from snippets that begin with the first token in a column.

Fix potential 32-bit integer overflow problems on the offset and length parameters to sqlite3_blob_read() and sqlite3_blob_write().  For sqlite3_blob_open(), make sure the *ppBlob return parameter is zeroed if the interface fails with SQLITE_MISUSE.
Propagate the COLLATE operator upward through function calls. Initial fix for ticket [ca0d20b6cdddec5e8].

Prevent partial indexes on the table on the left hand side of a LEFT JOIN from being incorrectly qualified by a constraint in the ON clause of the join. This relaxes the rule introduced by the previous commit (as the partial indexes on the table on the rhs of the LEFT JOIN may now be qualified by terms within the ON clause).
Fix problems with reverse order sorting and indexes in the LIKE optimization.
Refactor some jump opcodes in the VDBE.  Add JumpZeroIncr and DecrJumpZero. Fix the LIKE optimization to work with DESC sort order.
Fix an FTS3/4 problem with handling empty tokenizer declarations (e.g. "CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE t(tokenize=);").
Silently ignore any attempt to add a prefix index for prefixes zero bytes in size to an fts3/4 table. Or any prefix index size so large that it overflows a 32-bit signed integer.
Fix a problem with creating virtual table with names specified using malformed utf-8 within utf-16 databases.
Fix a problem causing collation sequence names to be dequoted multiple times under some circumstances.
Correctly detect the error of having a "*" wildcard on a SELECT without a FROM clause on the left-hand side of a recursive CTE.
Avoid a segfault if NULL is passed as the first argument to SQL scalar function fts3_tokenizer().
Fix a potential NULL pointer dereference following a syntax error.
Prevent a possible infinite loop when trying to DROP a table from a corrupt database.
Fix a problem with resolving ORDER BY clauses that feature COLLATE clauses attached to compound SELECT statements.
Fix a problem with fts3 prefix terms within phrase queries on "order=DESC" tables with a mix of negative and positive rowids.
Further changes to guard against integer overflow in the width and precision of printf() arguments.
Fix a problem with sorting large amounts of partially ordered data.
Do not assume an index contains unique entries unless it is declared UNIQUE and NOT NULL is specified for all columns. Fix for [7b4fee9f6c].
Avoid problems when a query has a GROUP BY and an ORDER BY but no FROM clause.
Fix a problem with a stale Select.pWith pointer when a CTE is used together with a compound query and an ORDER BY clause.
Remove an incorrect ALWAYS() from the table_info pragma.
Remove an incorrect assert() statement from sqlite3Fts3Dequote().
Fix a problem causing an assert() to fail if a snippet containing 0 tokens was requested from fts3.
An oversize hex literal can cause a parsing error while generating code for constants that are factored out of the main body of the VDBE program.  So allow for that case.
Fix a faulty assert() in the sqlite3StrAccumAppend() routine.
Make sure errors in coding triggers are propagated back up to the parser.
Fix a problem affecting some fts3 UPDATE and DELETE statements on order=DESC tables.
Fix an incorrect assert() statement in the CREATE INDEX code generator.
Fix a faulty assert in the schema parsing logic.
Bring comments on the INSERT code generator up-to-date.  Fix the INSERT code generator so that it correctly handles inserts from a SELECT into a virtual table with non-terminal hidden columns.
Fix a broken assert() and comparison for INSERT INTO ... SELECT when the SELECT uses an unknown collating sequence.
Fix a potential NULL pointer deference on a corrupt database schema.
Fix an fts4 problem to do with the handling of phrases that contain zero tokens.
Fix an obscure problem with "INSERT INTO tbl(cols) SELECT" statements where the SELECT is a compound with an ORDER BY and "cols" is a strict subset of tbl's columns.
Fix some identifier name de-quoting issues in the foreign key and trigger logic.
Fix a problem causing the fts3 integrity-check to fail if run inside a transaction.
Fix a faulty assert() in the btree part of the "PRAGMA page_size = ?" code.
Simplifications to error message processing.  Fix a possible problem in error message formatting when vacuuming a database with a corrupt schema.
Fix an assert() in btree routine freeSpace() that may be false if the database is corrupt.
Return SQLITE_CORRUPT to the user if an attempt is made to add database page 1 to the free page list.
Fix a problem with ignoring UNIQUE constraints on WITHOUT ROWID tables rendered redundant by the PRIMARY KEY.
Ensure that the CREATE TABLE AS statement correctly undoes partial changes to the sqlite_master table if the SELECT on the right-hand side aborts with an error.  Fix for ticket [873cae2b6e25b]
Pervent the likelihood() function from moving ON clause terms of a LEFT JOIN into the WHERE clause. Fix for ticket [5f60b11fc8e23490e2]
When creating an automatic-index on a sub-query, add a unique integer to the end of each index key to ensure the entire key is unique. Fix for [8a2adec1].
Avoid automatically rolling back the transaction if an SQLITE_IOERR or SQLITE_FULL error occurs within sqlite3_db_cacheflush().

If a table-constraint PRIMARY KEY lists a single column in single-quotes and that column has type INTEGER, then make that column an integer primary key, for historical compatibility.  Fix for ticket [ac661962a2aeab3c331].
Test cases.  Minor problems fixed.  All appears to work now.
Do not allow table-valued function syntax on ordinary tables and views as those objects are not table-valued functions. Fix for ticket [73eba7ba5c7c0fc].
Remove an incorrect ALWAYS() macro.  Fix for ticket [e5c6268dd807fa8950] - a problem introduced in SQLite 3.9.0 and found by libFuzzer.
Fix the spellfix1_scriptcode() function to ignore whitespace and punctuation, and to recognize hebrew and arabic scripts.
Fix the fts5 integrity-check code so that it works with detail=none tables.
Fix some problems with fts5 detail=none tables. Some still remain.
Changes to run many fts5 tests with detail=none and detail=col tables as well as the default detail=full. Also fixes for the bugs uncovered by running said tests.
Bug fix: the conflict resolution behavior for the implied NOT NULL constraint on the PRIMARY KEY of a WITHOUT ROWID table should be ABORT.
Fix an fts5 problem involving detail=none, "ORDER BY rowid DESC" and deleted items. Also add tests to verify that the documented operator precedences are correct.

When the [https://www.sqlite.org/queryplanner.html#partialsort|block sorting optimization] is used in a scalar subquery, be sure to exit the loop as soon as the first valid output row is received.  Fix for ticket [cb3aa0641d9a4].

Case folding in the LIKE operator should look at all bits of the character, not just the lower 8 bits.  Fix for ticket [80369eddd5c94].  This is a back-out of check-in [0a99a8c4facf] with a testcase added.
Fix issues on unix with opening database files via symlinks that are not in the current working directory. And with nested symlinks.
A different way to clear the subtype on VDBE registers when the value of the register is overwritten with new content. To fix [[f45ac567eaa9f93].
Handle parser stack overflow when parsing fts5 query expressions. Fix some compiler warnings in fts5 code.
Fix a fairly obscure buffer overread in fts5.
Use a separate list of aux-data structures for each trigger program at the VDBE level. Fix for [dc9b1c91].
Fix an fts5 problem causing 'optimize' to corrupt the fts index under some circumstances.
Fix an fts5 problem causing 'optimize' to corrupt the fts index under some circumstances. Cherrypick of [251d6473f7].
Fix a problem in the previous commit affecting queries with three or more tables joined together to the right of a LEFT or CROSS JOIN operator.
When optimizing expressions of the form "x IN (SELECT ...)" make sure that the subquery is not correlated.  Fix for ticket [5e3c886796e5512].

Fix a problem in fts3/4 that was causing it to discard data cached in-memory if an 'optimize' command is run when there is no data on disk. The usual way this would happen is if the very first transaction that writes to the fts3/4 table also includes an 'optimize' command.
Fix handling of strings that contain zero tokens in fts5. And other problems found by fuzzing.
Add tests to this branch. Fix a problem with temporary databases in auto-vacuum mode.
Fix a problem in the code generator for joins on virtual tables where the outer loop of the join uses the IN operator.
Fix the sqlite3BtreeDelete() routine so that it preserves the correct key even when the row being deleted is not on a leaf page. Fix for ticket [a306e56ff68b8fa56]
Remove quotes from identifiers used as datatype names in a CREATE TABLE statement.  Fix for ticket [7d7525cb01b68]
When checking for the WHERE-clause push-down optimization, verify that all terms of the compound inner SELECT are non-aggregate, not just the last term.  Fix for ticket [f7f8c97e97597].
Disable the multi-row one-pass DELETE optimization when the WHERE clause contains a subquery.  Fix for ticket [dc6ebeda9396087].

Disable the PagerDontWrite() optimization for temp tables. It can cause database corruption if a page passed to PagerDontWrite() is dirty at the start of a transaction that is subsequently rolled back.
In the WHERE generator, when building code for a DELETE operation, make sure that seeks to the main table are not deferred. This is a better fix for the [16c9801ceba49] bug than the previous.
Do not scan indexes that have the integer primary key as their left-most column.  This fixes the crash of ticket [16c9801ceba] but it seems like the wrong fix.  More investigation needed.
Fix the FTS5 xQueryPhrase() API function so that it recognizes column filters.
Fix a problem in sqlite3PagerMovepage() when working on a temp table for which pages have been spilled.
Fix ALTER TABLE so that it does not promote the schema version past 3, as that will cause DESC indexes to go corrupt. Ticket [f68bf68513a1c].
Make sure affinity is applied correctly on lower-bound range constraints in the min() optimization.  Fix for ticket [a0bac8b3c3d1bb].
Fix a problem with IN(...) constraints where the LHS is a sub-select that is an aggregate query.
Fix a problem introduced by [77948b5eceab92a7] causing duplicate calls to be made to the xSavepoint() method of virtual tables under some circumstances.
Fix a problem with estimating the number of rows visited by a query that uses a multi-column IN(SELECT...) constraint.
Remove an incorrect ALWAYS() statement and add a test case to show when the condition is sometimes false.
Fix the EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN output for row value range constaints that use an index.
Fix some problems with handling "no such collation sequence" errors.
Fix a SQL NULL handling bug in the vector IN operator code generation.
Fix other minor problems with the fts5 snippet() function.
Fix the vector BETWEEN operator so that it only evaluates the left-most vector expression once.  Add support for vector comparisons in the CASE operator.
Fix a bug in the fts5 snippet function causing it to return text containing zero phrase instances.
Fix a buffer overrun in the code for handling IN(...) operators when the LHS of the operator contains indexed columns or expressions.
Fix a problem causing the affinity of sub-select row-value elements to be ignored in some contextes.
Consider the affinity of "b" when using an "a IN (SELECT b ...)" expression with an index on "a". Fix for [199df416].
The ORDER BY LIMIT optimization is not valid unless the inner-most IN operator loop is actually used by the query plan. Fix for ticket [0c4df46116e90f92].
Fix a segfault introduced by the row-value enhancement that comes up on a skip-scan where the first term of the index is unconstrained and the second term is of the form "columm IN (SELECT...)".
Fix a problem with the fts5 auxiliary function API causing a crash when a query contained a phrase of zero terms.
Make sure the sqlite_sequence table is updated when an optional xfer optimization is used.  Fix for ticket [7b3328086a5c1].
When handling ORDER BY expressions, do not assume all values of an indexed expressions are distinct. Fix for [4766f444].
Make sure indexes on expressions skip over initial NULL values in the index.  Fix for ticket [4baa464912129477f3c9]
Fix a problem affecting queries that match the pattern (... WHERE ipk IN (....) ORDER BY ? LIMIT ?). Fix for [96c1454c].
Make sure left-join markings are transferred to the virtual scalar subexpressions when decomposing a vector comparison in the ON clause of a LEFT JOIN. Fix for ticket [fef4bb4bd9185ec8f].

Fix an issue that was causing the new database image to be assembled entirely in heap memory when VACUUMing a database, even if it should use a temp file. This could cause SQLITE_NOMEM errors when vacuuming very large databases on 32-bit systems.
Take care not to try to generate code for the ATTACH and DETACH commands if there were syntax errors during parsing. Fix for ticket [2f1b168ab4d4844]
Fix a problem with switching from wal to rollback mode when SQLITE_DBCONFIG_NO_CKPT_ON_CLOSE is configured.
Fix an fts5 problem causing a crash in phrase queries where the first token of the phrase matches one or more rows but some other token within the phrase matches zero.
Code constant vector components outside of any loops in CASE and BETWEEN expressions. Fix for [1a684656].
Fix then handling of the (oversized) integer literal -0x8000000000000000.
Avoid clearing the EP_FromJoin flag from terms in ON clauses when flattening sub-selects. Possible fix for [2df0107b].
Fix an fts5 bug that could cause a crash following an OOM error or sqlite3_interrupt() interrupt.

Fix a problem causing SQLite to return false "foreign key violation" errors when there is a partial (i.e. WHERE constrained) UNIQUE index on the parent key columns. This bug did not cause SQLite to allow illegal data to be inserted into the database, only to reject legal operations.
Fix a problem preventing FTS5 from correctly passing the FTS5_TOKENIZE_PREFIX flag to custom tokenizer implementations.
Fix a problem causing the pre-update hook to be invoked by DROP TABLE statements.
Ensure that indexed expressions with collating sequences are handled correctly.  Proposed fix for ticket [eb703ba7b50c1a5].
Fix an FTS5 problem that could cause a crash when certain queries were interrupted using sqlite3_interrupt().
Fix a case introduced by [4cd2a967] where a corrupt database could cause a buffer overwrite.

Fix a problem in the enhanced PRAGMA integrity_check where it verifies CHECK constraints: Do not be confused by the reuse of the Table.pCheck field by VIEWs with named columns.  Problem discovered by OSS-Fuzz.
Remove an invalid assert() statement failing when VACUUMing a database that contains an index on a column explicitly declared "COLLATE BINARY".
Various fixes to the json_merge_patch() function.
Fix the OP_Once opcode so that it works correctly for recursive triggers. Ticket [06796225f59c057cd120f1].
Fix an error in the new json_patch() routine discovered by Ralf Junker.

Fix a problem causing "PRAGMA integrity_check" to disable the xfer optimization for subsequent VACUUM operations on tables with one or more CHECK constraints. This could result in VACUUM producing slightly larger database files.
Disallow leading zeros on numeric constants in JSON. Fix for ticket [b93be8729a895a528e2]
Change the JSON extension so that it disallows control characters inside of strings.  Fix for ticket [6c9b5514077fed34551f98e64c09a10dc2fc8e16].
New test cases and minor fixes for the optimization on this branch.

Fix a problem in "PRAGMA foreign_key_check" in handling a WITHOUT ROWID child table with an INTEGER PRIMARY KEY parent key. Also, if an FK violation is detected in a WITHOUT ROWID child table, do not try to read and return the rowid. The third column returned by "PRAGMA foreign_key_check" in this case (WITHOUT ROWID child table) is now always set to NULL.
Fix an FTS5 bug that could cause a prefix-query without a prefix-index on a database that contains delete-markers to return extra, non-matching, rows.
Clear the BTCF_ValidNKey flag set if a cursor is moved by sqlite3BtreeInsert(). Fix for [f68dc596c4].
Do not save the state of an fts5 merge operation mid-way through an input term, even if no previous entry for that term has caused any output. Doing so may corrupt the FTS index.
Ensure that the expression rewriter inside the query flattener decends into the substructure of the TK_IF_NULL_ROW operator.  This is a continuation of the fix for ticket [cad1ab4cb7b0fc344].
Ensure that the expression rewriter inside the query flattener decends into the substructure of the TK_IF_NULL_ROW operator.  This is a continuation of the fix for ticket [cad1ab4cb7b0fc344].
Ensure pointer map entries are always added when a row that does use overflow pages replaces one that does not in an auto-vacuum database. Fix for [fda22108].
Ensure that the query planner knows that any column of a flattened LEFT JOIN can be NULL even if that column is labeled with "NOT NULL". Fix for ticket [892fc34f173e99d8].

Fix a virtual table problem that can occur when the vtab is on the RHS of a LEFT JOIN and there is a MATCH constraint in the ON clause, or when the vtab is in a sub-query that is the RHS of a LEFT JOIN and there is a MATCH constraint in the WHERE clause of the sub-query.
Fix a crash in unionvtab caused by a misconfiguration. Add other test cases for the same.
Avoid creating an automatic index on the RHS of a LEFT JOIN to optimize an IS term. Fix for [ce68383b].

Combine the Parse.ckBase and Parse.iSelfTab fields into just Parse.iSelfTab. This fixes a problem with date/time functions in check-constraints.  Add some test cases for date/time functions in index expressions and check constraints.
Correctly handle an "INTEGER PRIMARY KEY UNIQUE" column in a WITHOUT ROWID table.  This is a fix for ticket [bc115541132dad136], a problem discovered by OSSFuzz.
Fix a segfault in swarmvtab that could occur if there was an error in the SQL statement passed to the constructor. Add other test cases.
Only use indexes on expressions to optimize ORDER BY and GROUP BY if the collation sequence matches. Possible fix for [e20dd54a].
Fix an error in [b22cdd67] that can cause a negative infinity to be (rarely) reported as a positive infinity.

Do not make the assumption (as check-in [4da49a95c0f07] incorrectly did) that the ExprList returned by sqlite3ExprListDup() would never be passed into sqlite3ExprListAppend().  Include a new test case that shows this sometimes does happen.
Fix the rendering of the P4_INTARRAY argument to the OP_IntegrityCk opcode in the output of EXPLAIN.
Fix a Pager ref-count leak in the sqlite_dbpage virtual table.
Fix a problem causing an INDEXED BY specifying an unusable partial index to be mishandled.

Fix the skip-ahead-distinct optimization on joins for cases there the table in the inner loop of the join does not contribute any columns to the result set.  Proposed fix for ticket [ef9318757b152e3a2]
Fix a problem in the omit-table-from-left-join optimization from check-in [0cd82ee9a8413cf] that was discovered by OSSFuzz.
Completely disable the skip-ahead-distinct optimization for all but the inner-most loop of a DISTINCT join.  Fix for ticket [ef9318757b152e3a26e9592]
Fix an assertion fault found by OSSFuzz.

Move the generation of output column names earlier in the case of a CREATE TABLE AS.  This is a fix for ticket [3b4450072511e62] and a continuation of check-in [ade7ddf1998190b2b63] that fixes cases of ticket [de3403bf5ae5f72ed6] that were missed previously.
Fix a NULL pointer dereference after a syntax error that can occur as a result of check-in [6b2ff26c25bb9da3] yesterday.  This problem was discovered by the OSSFuzz.
Fix crashes that could occur if SQL NULL values were passed to the built-in FTS5 snippet function. Edit: breaks amalgamation builds.
Fix a zipfile problem with adding new directories to an archive.
Fix a problem in os_unix.c causing it to return SQLITE_CANTOPEN instead of SQLITE_READONLY_RECOVERY.
Fix a problem causing zipfile to store 0 in place of the CRC32 value for uncompressed files.
Fix a problem causing an infinite loop or other malfunction in some UPDATE statements with an OR term in the WHERE clause.
Fix a bug causing spurious "sub-select returns N columns expected 1" errors in join queries with a term like "(a, b) IN (SELECT ...)" in the WHERE clause.
Proposed fix for the query planner problem of ticket [ec32177c99ccac2b1].
Fix a failing assert() in the new code on this branch.
Fix a problem triggered when a zipfile virtual table is created and written to within the same transaction. And add other zipfile test.

Fix an incorrect table lookup used to find the appropriate search operator for a WHERE clause on a row-value inequality.  The incorrect table lookup was causing an incorrect answer for the less-than operator. Fix for ticket [f484b65f3d6230593c34f11]
Ensure that multiple updates of the same FTS4 row (i.e. the row with the same rowid) within a single transaction are written to separate segments. Fix for [d6ec09ec].

Do not allow parameters or schema references inside of WITH clause of triggers and views.  This fixes a bug discovered by OSSFuzz and present since common-table-expressions were first added in 2014-02-03.
Test cases and a bug fix on the new unicode handling in %c.
Always interpret non-zero floating-point values as true even if their integer part is zero.  Fix for ticket [36fae083b450e3af857a459e20].
Get the "DEFAULT true" and "DEFAULT false" phrases working correctly in CREATE TABLE.
Fix handling of "UPDATE OR REPLACE" statements run on zipfile virtual tables.
Fix the ANALYZE command so that it will process tables whose names begin with "sqlite" as long as they do not being with "sqlite_".
Yet another fault in the sqlite3ExprImpliesNotNull() routine, causing errors in the LEFT JOIN strength reduction optimization of check-in [dd568c27b1d76563].

Bug fix in the LEFT JOIN strength reduction optimization of check-in [dd568c27b1d76563].  The sqlite3ExprImpliesNotNull() routine was mistakenly assuming that a CASE expression must always be NULL if contained any reference to a variable that was NULL.

The push-down optimization was being too aggressive such that it sometimes generated incorrect results.  Reinstate the restriction (4) (with qualifications) that was removed by check-ins [b5d3dd8cb0b1e4] and [dd568c27b1d765].
Fix segfault in 'eval.c' extension when used with 'empty_result_callbacks'.
Fix an instance where an uninitialized VM register might be accessed. Fix for [093420fc0]. This problem was found by OSSFuzz.

Fix a problem causing the LEFT JOIN strength reduction optimization to be incorrectly applied in some cases where the WHERE clause of the query contains a filter expression of the form "lhs.x IS NOT ?".
Fix a problem in the new upsert implemention, discovered by OSSFuzz.
Fix the handling of "PRAGMA count_changes=ON" with UPSERT.  Also improved the implementation of count_changes in other places, without changing the behavior.
Fix UPSERT so that it plays nicely with AUTOINCREMENT.
Do not attempt to use terms from the WHERE clause to drive indexes on the right table of a LEFT JOIN.  Fix for ticket [4ba5abf65c5b0f9a96a7a40cd18b]
Do not attempt to read values from indexes-on-expressions if the index is on the RHS of a LEFT JOIN. This won't work if the index cursor points at a null-row. Fix for [7fa80496].
Fix a problem with processing "LEFT JOIN tbl ON tbl.a = ? AND (tbl.b=? OR tbl.c=?)" in cases where there are indexes on both tbl(a, b) and tbl(a, c).
Fix a problem in the xBestIndex method of the closure extension causing it to allocate non-contiguous argvIndex values in some cases (an "xBestIndex malfunction" error).

In an ORDER BY LIMIT, make sure the ORDER BY expression evaluator does not try to reuse values from the result set if the result set has not yet be computed.  This fixes a bug in the recent deferred-row loading optimization, check-in [c381f0ea57002a264fd958b28e]. OSSFuzz discovered the problem.
Verify that the sqlite_sequence table exists and is in approximately the correct format prior to using it to process an autoincrement table. Fix for ticket [d8dc2b3a58cd5dc2918a1d4a].
Fix the CSV extension so that it works with single-column CSV files.
Fix handling of window frames containing negative number of rows. e.g. "ROWS x PRECEDING AND y PRECEDING" where (x<y).
Fix some problems with using window-functions in aggregate queries.
Fix a problem with handling of statements containing two or more different windows.
Fix problem with window functions min() and max() when used with a PARTITION clause and a frame starting point other than "UNBOUNDED PRECEDING".
Fix a bug in the lead() and lag() window functions causing them to fail when used in queries featuring multiple window functions.
Fix another problem in lead()/lag(). And some errors that could occur following OOM faults.
Fix problems with using window functions in CREATE VIEW statements.
Fix a problem caused by a sub-query containing a window function in the FROM clause of a query that itself uses a window function.
Fix a problem with using min() or max() as a window function.
Add tests to improve coverage of code in window.c. Fix a problem with "SELECT row_number() OVER ()".
Fix a problem with handling single row partitions in the percent_rank() window function.
Fix a problem with using LIMIT in window-function queries.
Fix a problem with using a window-function SELECT as a FROM clause sub-query in some circumstances.
Fix another problem that could cause a crash when a window function was used in a view.
Fix a problem in the xInverse callback for the built-in sum() window function.
Fix a segfault caused by invoking a regular aggregate as a window-function. And some problems with count(*) when used as a window-function.
Fix a problem in the xInverse method of window-function group_concat(1).
Remove some bad assert() statements from the implementations of window functions percent_rank() and cume_dist().
Fix a bad assert() in window.c.
Fix a problem with using scalar sub-selects in window function queries.

On an UPSERT when the order of constraint checks is rearranged, make sure that the affinity transformations on the inserted content occur before any of the constraint checks.  Fix for ticket [79cad5e4b2e219dd197242e9e5f4e].
Do not abort running queries due to a CREATE INDEX statement.  Allow them to run to completion before being reprepared.  Fix for ticket [c694113e50321afdf9].
Fix a bug causing ALTER TABLE RENAME COLUMN to fail when renaming an IPK column that is used in a CHECK constraint.
Fix a bug causing all ALTER TABLE RENAME COLUMN commands to fail if ANALYZE had been run on the database. Also prevent the user from renaming the columns of system tables.
Fix EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN so that it describes IN operators implemented using a ROWID lookup.

Avoid incorrectly replacing tokens that refer to a column being renamed via an alias. For example, do not overwrite "xyz" when "a" is renamed in "CREATE VIEW v1 AS SELECT a AS xyz FROM tbl WHERE xyz=1"
Fix a problem with renaming a column in a table that has a temp trigger that references another attached database.
Fix some test script errors. And an incorrect assert() in fts5.
Fix a problem with renaming a non-temp table that has at least one temp trigger and shares its name with a temp table.
Fix a problem with processing a "vtab.col IS NULL" expression within the WHERE clause of a query when "vtab" is a virtual table on the rhs of a LEFT JOIN.

Fix the LIKE optimization so that it is disabled when the LHS of the expression does not have TEXT affinity and the RHS is the pattern '/%' or the RHS begins with the escape character. Fix for ticket [c94369cae9b561b1f996d0054b].
First proposed fix for the ALTER TABLE problem described by ticket [b41031ea2b5372378cb3d2d]

Disable the ORDER BY LIMIT optimization in queries using window functions. This fixes a problem that was introduced by check-in [206720129ed2fa8875a286] which attempted to fix ticket [9936b2fa443fec03ff25f9].  This changes is a fix for the follow-in tocket [510cde277783b5fb5de628].
Fix a problem with views that use window functions as part of complex expressions.
Fix a problem with ALTER TABLE commands when the schema features an INSTEAD of trigger that uses NEW.* or OLD.*.
In the unix VFS, fix the heap shm allocator (used for unix-excl) so that it works even on systems where the page size is larger than 32KB.
Fix a problem with using window functions in compound (UNION, INTERSECT etc.) queries.
In the WHERE-constraint propagation optimization, if there are duplicate constraint, make sure only one of them propagates.  Proposed fix for ticket [cf5ed20fc8621b165].
Add extra defenses against strategically corrupt databases to fts3/4.
Fix a assert() in the query planner that can arise when doing row-value operations on a PRIMARY KEY that contains duplicate columns. Ticket [1a84668dcfdebaf12415d].

Eponymous virtual tables appear to exist in all schemas. This is an alternative and improved fix to the eponymous virtual table in trigger problem that was previously addressed by checkin [1fa74930ab56171e].
Fix a problem with virtual table "fsdir" and some join queries.
Fix problems in pragma.c causing some PRAGMA statements to test the wrong schema-cookie before proceeding, or to try to open cursors on the wrong database ("PRAGMA foreign_key_check" only).
Fix a failing assert() in sqlite3ResetAllSchemasOfConnection().
Fix a parser bug in the use of parentheses around table-valued functions.
Do not use a partial index as a table scan in an IN operator. Fix for ticket [1d958d90596593a77420e59].
Fix a problem in sqlite3BtreeDelete() in which deleting an entry from a corrupt database can leave a btree page with zero cells.
Posible fix for [d96eba87].
Fix a bug in the code that detects self-referencing rows as part of foreign key processing. Fix for [50d2a6c2].
Remove an assert() that could fail on a corrupt db from fts3_write.c.

Add new sqlite3_prepare_v3() flag SQLITE_PREPARE_NO_VTAB, for preparing statements that are not allowed to use any virtual tables. Use this to prevent circular references in triggers on virtual table shadow tables from causing resource leaks.
Fix an assert() in fts5 that could fail with a corrupt database.
Do not all REPLACE to sneak a NULL value into a NOT NULL column.  Detect that situation and ABORT instead.  Fix for ticket [e6f1f2e34dceeb1ed61531c7e98].
Change another fts5 assert() that may fail with a corrupt database to an assert_nc().
Fix a problem with the CSV extension when it uses the "header" option on a real file.
Fix another problem in fts5 caused by a corrupt schema record.
Fix a null-pointer dereference that could occur in fts5 with a corrupt database.
Fix a problem causing the sqlite_master entry corresponding to a virtual table to be removed by a DROP TABLE even if the call to the vtabs xDestroy() method failed.
Fix another fts5 problem caused by a corrupt database.
Raise an error if the argument to VACUUM INTO is an identifier.
Fix another fts5 assert() that may fail if the database is corrupt.
Enhance the ALTER TABLE RENAME COLUMN feature so that it works on tables that have redundant UNIQUE and/or PRIMARY KEY constraints. Fix for ticket [bc8d94f0fbd633fd9a051e3]
Avoid use-after-free and double-free errors that could occur if an fts5 table is modified in certain ways while there are active cursors.
Fix a segfault in fts3 prompted by a corrupted database.

Fix a problem handling a negative value in the "number-of-pages" database header field. Also a problem with running "REINDEX tbl" against a virtual table for which the SQL passed to sqlite3_declare_vtab() contains PRIMARY KEY or UNIQUE constraints.
Fix a problem with corrupt database handling in the fts3 matchinfo() function.
Fix another problem with handling corrupt records in fts5_decode().
Fix a problem causing a crash if an fts5vocab table was created to query an fts3/4 FTS index.
Fix a problem with querying a corrupt fts3 database.
Handle SQL NULL values without crashing in the fts5 snippet() and highlight() functions.
Fix a problem with ALTER TABLE and vector assignments in UPDATE statements within triggers.
Fix a problem in the fts3 matchinfo() function with corrupt database handling.
Fix a problem with fix [b4b57413].
Fix a problem with renaming a column that is used as part of an ORDER BY on a compound SELECT within a database view or trigger.
Fix a memory leak that could occur in fts3 when handling a corrupt database.
Fix a problem in the code generator for sorting results with SRT_EphemTab and a LIMIT clause.

Fix a corner-case for the logic that cause an insert of a NULL into an INTEGER PRIMARY KEY column to be converted into a valid integer key, when the NULL results from a CASE expression that lacks an ELSE clause.
Fix problems with joining two or more fts5_vocab tables that access the same underlying fts5 table.
Fix a buffer overwrite that could occur when running an fts5 prefix query against a corrupt database.
Fix a crash in the fts5vocab module caused by including a "term < NULL" term in a WHERE clause.
Fix problems causing undefined left-shift operations in the fts3 snippet() function.
Fix a fairly obscure problem allowing an "ALTER TABLE RENAME col TO ..." statement to modify the schema in such a way as to break a reference within a trigger program.
Fix an infinite loop caused by a corrupt database in fts3. Also an undefined left-shift in fts5.
Avoid a division-by-zero error in fts5 caused by a corrupt database.

Remove a broken assert() triggered by a "PRAGMA max_page_count = N" invocation, where N is larger than the number of pages in the database image, but smaller than the number of pages in the database file.
Fix another segfault caused by a corrupt fts3 database.
Fix problems with sub-selects in WINDOW definitions. Also rename-column operations when the column being renamed appears in a WINDOW definition that is part of a VIEW or TRIGGER.
Fix an assert() in vdbemem.c that could fire if the database was corrupt.
Fix a potential problem with "INSERT INTO ... SELECT * FROM" (or VACUUM) statements on a corrupted database.
Fix a couple of assert() statments in btree.c that could fail with corrupt databases.
Do not accidently truncate zeroblob values when doing an arithmetic operation.  Fix for ticket [bb4bdb9f7f654b0bb9f34cfba].
